tasks.title: Adversarially review the two derivation proposals filed with the activation of GOAL-ECDLP2M-001: the Frobenius-orbit congruence closure (IDEA-20260918-6c07e1) and the Frobenius-stable-subspace count (IDEA-20260918-9abf42)

handoff.objective: Attack two derivations and return a SEPARATE written verdict on each. (1) IDEA-20260918-6c07e1 (question RQ-QSP-f9bbdb): that no F_2-coefficient quasi-subfield polynomial X^(2^n') + lambda(X) splits completely over F_(2^131) at any n' in [2, 129], for any degree, because the root set is Frobenius-stable, 131 is prime so |V| = a + 131b with a in {0,1,2}, complete splitting demands |V| = 2^n' exactly, and 2^n' mod 131 lies in {1, 2} only at n' in {1, 130, 131} since ord_131(2) = 130. (2) IDEA-20260918-9abf42 (question RQ-FROB-7d8dd4): that for n an odd prime F_(2^n) has EXACTLY 2^f Frobenius-stable F_2-subspaces with f = 1 + (n-1)/ord_n(2), their dimensions being the subset sums of the irreducible factor degrees of T^n - 1; that at n = 131 this gives exactly four, of dimensions 0, 1, 130, 131; that this re-derives Proposition 2 of KN-LIT-4fe9d2; and that this program's toy ladders are uncontrolled for ord_n(2). Both are `status: proposed`, `novelty_status: unverified`, and BOTH WERE AUTHORED BY THE COORDINATOR THAT DISPATCHED THIS CARD. Treat that as an aggravating circumstance, not a mitigating one.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether either argument survives adversarial reading. If (1) holds, a negative currently scoped by DEC-20260917-793ae2 to "the 732 enumerated candidates and on nothing else" extends to every n' in [2, 129] and every degree at zero compute -- a very large extension bought very cheaply, which is exactly the shape of claim that must be broken before it is believed. If (2) holds, the FROB line's accumulated null results acquire a stated confound and a redesigned ladder. If either breaks, that is the cheaper and equally useful outcome.
constraints: C-1: ZERO COMPUTE IN THE SENSE OF RUNS: maximum_runs is 0 and no experiment is executed, no run record is created, and nothing is written under experiments/. Arithmetic done by hand or in a scratch interpreter to CHECK a stated number is expected and welcome; it is a review activity, not a run, and its results belong in the report, never in a run record or an evidence record.

C-2: RETURN A SEPARATE VERDICT ON EACH OF THE TWO PROPOSALS. Do not compose them, do not average them, and do not let a break in one colour the other. They are filed under different research questions and share only the integer ord_n(2).

C-3: EDIT NO RECORD. Both proposals are committed ledger records and are immutable. A defect is reported in your report; it is never patched in place. If a proposal must change, the remedy is a superseding record minted by the Coordinator, not an edit.

C-4: ATTACK, DO NOT IMPROVE. The value of this round is a break, and the cheapest breaks are named in the review_plan below. Do not spend the round strengthening an argument you think is basically right; if it is basically right, say which step is load-bearing and how a reader could check it, and move to the next joint.
C-5: DECLARE WHAT YOU READ, COMPLETELY AND HONESTLY, in a `review_attestation` block per templates/research-records.md. Your `verdict` is per joint owned, not a vote on the whole claim.

C-6: THE PROPOSER IS THE DISPATCHER. Both proposals are `proposed_by: coordinator` and this card was written by the same role. If any part of the framing below looks designed to be survivable -- a joint that cannot fail, a control aimed away from the weak step -- SAY SO IN THE REPORT. That finding is worth more than a verdict on the mathematics.

C-7: NOTHING YOU RETURN CHANGES A STATUS. A verdict of `holds` on either proposal does not promote it, does not extend any scoped negative, and does not license any record to cite it. Only a subsequent committed Coordinator decision can do that (DEC-20260918-7e0865 NA-6).

IDEA-20260916-3f7a1c's own minimal_test already contemplates n' in {11, 22} as brute-force cross-check cells, so this is a widening of a design that exists rather than a new one.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the n = 131 census is right at all. EV-QSP-a6aa4b discloses that 720 of its 732 rows (98.4%) are SINGLE-INSTRUMENT, and that its re-verifier can falsify a listed root but "cannot detect a missing one" -- a one-directional check on the quantity every cost row of the QSP line is built from. constraints: C-1: DESIGN ONLY. Author a hypothesis record and a frozen experiment contract at version 1 with `approved_by: null`. DESIGNING IS NOT APPROVING (AGENTS.md "ECC comes first", instruction 3): approval is a separate committed Coordinator decision, and execution is a separate /run invocation after that.

C-2: RUN NOTHING. maximum_runs is 0. Do not execute a census, a spot check, a prototype, or a timing measurement, and do not create any directory under experiments/<new id>/runs/ beyond an empty .gitkeep. A number produced by this task would be a measurement taken before its own protocol was frozen, which is the defect the freeze exists to prevent.

C-3: THE INDEPENDENCE OF THE SECOND INSTRUMENT IS DECLARED IN THE CONTRACT AS A BLIND_FROM LIST, NOT PROMISED IN PROSE. Name the exact paths the implementer may not read -- at minimum EXP-QSP-33b442's implementation directory, its run artifacts, its execution report, and its analysis -- and require the executor's report to declare what it actually read. An independence that is not checkable after the fact is not independence.

C-4: EDIT NO EXISTING RECORD. EXP-QSP-33b442, H-QSP-5540d7, EV-QSP-a6aa4b, DEC-20260917-793ae2 and IDEA-20260916-3f7a1c are all immutable. In particular, DO NOT convert IDEA-20260916-3f7a1c by editing it; its `status: proposed` is historically accurate and the new hypothesis CITES it as its source proposal.

C-5: PREREGISTER THE PREDICTION FOR n' = 3..14 IN THE CONTRACT'S `preregistered_prediction` BLOCK, derived from a stated null model and NOT from any unrun computation (see motivation above). The cells are uncovered by any committed run, so the prediction is genuinely blind and that is a feature: it is the only cell set in this line where a preregistration has not already seen the answer.

C-6: CARRY A PROOF_SEARCH_MAP AND CONTROLS. The hypothesis is proof-adjacent (it rests on IDEA-20260916-3f7a1c's derivation (A)) so docs/inventor-protocol.md section 8 applies: baseline reproduction, observation collision, quantifier order, method ceiling with a nearby object control. Carry forward IDEA-20260916-3f7a1c's own controls, all of which are already worked there: the brute-force cross-check, the proves-too-much objects ((7,3) -> 8, (31,15) -> 2^15, subfield (12,6) -> 64), the null object, the linearized control, and the degenerate-candidate arm for square lambda.

C-7: SCOPE THE CELLS HONESTLY AND SIZE THEM AGAINST THE RECORDED IMPEDIMENT. At n' = 3..14 the direct gcd route needs a polynomial of degree 2^n' <= 2^14, which is small; at n' = 33 it needs 2^33, which is the impediment that forced AMD-20260917-001 and the absence of a sub-quadratic GF(2)[X] engine (DEC-20260917-793ae2 NA-6 item iii). Design the low cells as directly computable and say explicitly which cells rest on a derivation rather than a brute count.

C-8: IF IDEA-20260918-6c07e1 SURVIVES TASK-20260918-190055, IT PREDICTS THE n' = 3..14 CELLS CONTAIN NO COMPLETE SPLITTER. Do NOT build that prediction into this contract: at design time that proposal is unreviewed and may not be cited as support (DEC-20260918-7e0865 limitations). Design the census to measure N_K(L) regardless; if the proposal later holds, the same measurements become a test of it, which is strictly better than having assumed it.
